\newcommand{\AoEndless}{Over the whole 27.56\,h stream (5,567 utterances, one process, no restart, no reset) the resident memory of H22ctl was 62.35\,MB at the start, 69.3\,MB once loaded, at most 69.53\,MB, and 67.85\,MB at the end; its word lag over 95,710 matched words was 310\,ms median and 439\,ms at the 95th percentile. \newcommand{\FrontierWarmCaption}{Warm, single harness, exploratory, Zen~2 (AMD Threadripper PRO 3995WX, shared host). Live streams per core sustained at p99 lateness of at most \LatenessBoundMs\,ms (top axis: per CCX, \DenWorkers{} single-threaded workers; \LadderScope) against WER on the 400 dev-clean utterances of the DEV panel, measured in the same harness for the same checkpoints. Dense: the latest checkpoint (average of steps 55/60/65k), greedy (circle) and beam~4 (diamond) at the same density. R0 and multirate come from the clean same-session run; in the dense run the loaded host cut R0 to \RzeroLoadedCCX{} streams per CCX, so that R0 is not used. Whiskers run to the first failed rung. Hollow: the earlier step-45k checkpoint, \DenDenseFortyFiveRangeLo--\DenDenseFortyFiveRangeHi{} streams per CCX over two runs.}

\newcommand{\RehearsalCaption}{Warm single-harness rehearsal (exploratory): R0 Zipformer INT8, the earlier dense average (steps 45/50/55k; the latest dense checkpoint of that harness is in \cref{fig:frontier}) and the multirate model at step 50k, all prepared INT8, in one \texttt{ultra bench-suite} executable on a shared AMD Threadripper PRO 3995WX (Zen~2). Density: \DenWorkers{} single-threaded workers on one CCX, \DenRungSeconds{}~s ladder rungs, one repeat; R0 and multirate densities were identical in \DenReproRuns{} runs; the earlier dense step-45k checkpoint reached \DenDenseFortyFiveRangeLo--\DenDenseFortyFiveRangeHi{} per CCX over two runs. Left: whole-service CPU-seconds per audio-second at the matched \MatchedRung-stream rung against WER on the panel's 400 dev-clean utterances, measured in the same harness and executable. Right: highest sustained streams per CCX, with each checkpoint's WER.}
\newcommand{\MoneyCaption}{Cold throughput is the median of three runs on one pinned Zen~2 core, including model load. The vertical axis shows dev-clean WER from the 730-utterance LibriSpeech DEV panel. \MoneyMarksCaption{} \MoneyWattsCaption{} \MoneyOursWatts{} \ColdHostShort{} \ColdSubsetSentence{} Exploratory.}
